Stephen Colbert aired his final show last night after Paramount fired him to appease Trump.

The Ellisons are now eyeing Warner Bros — and Trump's eager to give it to them.

His media takeover is happening in broad daylight. Here's what we can do about it.

Memorial Day food staple prices are up an average of 13%.

Americans will spend $2B more on gas over the holiday weekend due to the highest gas prices in nearly four years.

Domestic plane tickets are 31% more expensive than in January.

Welcome to Trump’s “New Golden Age.”

The twin issues of an economy that’s unaffordable for most Americans and a system overwhelmed with corruption are closely linked.

Here is how Democrats must respond to Trump's "Corruptonomics."

robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Forget AI.

Here's what I hope the Class of 2026 actually embraces.

Video

Bust up big corporations and tackle Wall Street’s greed.

Get big money out of politics.

Strengthen unions and boost wages.

Pass Medicare for all, paid leave, universal childcare, and so much more...

This is the agenda Democrats need to fight for.

It's not enough to simply be anti-Trump.

With the midterms approaching, Trump and Republicans are trying to tout their big, ugly bill as the “Working Families’ Tax Cut.”

Don’t fall for their lies. This bill was a massive giveaway to the rich and powerful.

Ohio’s state sales tax exemption for data centers cost $1.6 BILLION in 2025 — 11x more than its original estimate.

That’s $1.6 billion that could have gone to public schools and healthcare instead of Big Tech CEOs’ pockets.

Is it any wonder communities are organizing against data centers? signalohio.org/ohio-data-cen…

Tobacco company Reynolds American donated $5 million to Trump’s super PAC.

Then, an executive and two of their lobbyists had lunch with Trump.

Days later, the FDA rolled out new guidance that would allow tobacco companies to start selling e-cigarettes.

Everything is for sale.

The Israel lobby, crypto industry, and AI companies are spending millions to buy this year's midterm elections.

And they're using shady campaign finance tactics to hide their involvement from the public.

Watch.

Trump's ever-expanding list of taxpayer grifts:

-$1.8B slush fund for political allies
-$1B for ballroom "security"
-$1B for Qatar jet refurbishments
-$230M in DOJ "compensation"
-$100M+ for golf outings

When he says he "doesn't think about Americans' financial situation," I believe him.

Airline ticket prices are surging.

A major culprit? Rising jet fuel costs due to Trump's Iran war.

But there's also the underlying concentration in the industry.

Airlines merged from 12 major carriers in 1980 to 4 today.

Less competition makes it easier for the biggest players to price-gouge.

The Class of 2026 is graduating into a gloomy economy, uncertain job prospects due to AI, and a democracy hanging by a thread.

But there’s still reason to hope. Here’s what I told 2026 UC Berkeley graduates. https://youtu.be/y2H5D4DhuO4

Friends, I’ve been around politics for over 50 years. I’ve never seen anything as brazenly crooked and corrupt as what Trump and his cronies did this week.

Poverty is a policy choice. Concentrated wealth is a policy choice. Inequality is a policy choice. None of it is natural or inevitable. Remember: We have the power to build a system that serves the many, not the powerful few.

Trump's shady IRS immunity deal is outright robbery from the American people.

Billions of dollars that Trump and his family have pocketed — from foreign governments, billionaires, and corporate supplicants — are now untraceable, unaccounted for, and likely hidden for good.

Corruption on steroids.

In Trump's second term, Bezos has received...

-Huge new tax cuts for himself and Amazon
-$260M+ in new Blue Origin federal contracts
-A slap-on-the wrist FTC settlement for Amazon
-A gutted NLRB led by a union-busting corporate lawyer

No wonder he's singing Trump's praises.

Why am I still hopeful about America, in spite of everything going on today?

Because young people are waking up and taking back their future.

Starbucks is abruptly scrapping its AI inventory tool for repeatedly miscounting and mislabeling items, just months after rolling it out at stores nationwide.

It's the latest warning that the widely-hyped "AI revolution" could be a bubble that's going to burst.

Random reminder that banning elected officials from trading stock is a total no brainer.

They can use privileged information to make money on the stock market, while they’re supposed to be working for you. 

Make no mistake — it’s legalized corruption.

I want to say thank you, and farewell, to Stephen Colbert before his final show this evening. But I also want to remind folks of the corruption behind his cancellation.  Watch.

Stephen Colbert has been one of the most thoughtful, funny, and genuinely decent people on television. I’ve always enjoyed his work — especially the Colbert Report. Here’s a clip from when I was a guest back in 2010. After this Thursday’s episode of The Late Show With Stephen Colbert, the Ed Sullivan Theater will go dark, and we’ll lose one of the nation’s funniest and most courageous, truthful, and gentlemanly critics of Trump and his lawless regime. Our society and democracy will be the worse

Today's primary between Thomas Massie and his Trump-backed challenger is the most expensive House primary in history. The pro-Israel lobby has spent millions on this race and others across the country. But it's not the only Big Money group trying to buy the midterms. Watch.
Friends, I’ve been around politics for over 50 years. I’ve never seen anything as brazenly crooked and corrupt as what Trump and his cronies did today.
Kudos to Zohran Mamdani for exposing the lie behind Ronald Reagan’s most famous quote. This is what true public service looks like.
I've worked for three presidents, including one Republican. No previous administration was this awash in corruption and conflicts of interest.
